options.goal: Choose which AI could run on this machine. Read the stored analysis first (load_analysis); it is not probed again. Ask the owner which AI they want (ask_owner which_ai, and which_cli, which_api_provider or sensitivity when it matters), look up the catalog and evidence if useful, build the options (build_options: code applies the filters and the order), then explain EACH option in plain words (explain_option). You do not rank.

done.reason: every option is explained and ready for the owner to pick one; nothing was installed

no_options.reason: no option survived the filters; the reasons are in the facts; nothing was installed
